@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The document g______ed that the diamond was real and of the highest quality.
= guaranteed
~詞義 guarantee（v.）保證
~原文 The document guaranteed that the diamond was real and of the highest quality.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: This board game requires a m______m of four players, but if more people want to join, there can be as many as ten.
= minimum
~詞義 minimum（n.）最少量
~原文 This board game requires a minimum of four players, but if more people want to join, there can be as many as ten.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: During the long hike, Alice's dog proved a loyal c______n, staying alert and close by her side on the narrow trails.
= companion
~詞義 companion（n.）同伴
~原文 During the long hike, Alice's dog proved a loyal companion, staying alert and close by her side on the narrow trails.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: So far, scientists have not found a definite e______n for how the universe was created.
= explanation
~詞義 explanation（n.）解釋
~原文 So far, scientists have not found a definite explanation for how the universe was created.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Rabbits are easy to b______d because they can produce babies in a period of only thirty days.
= breed
~詞義 breed（v.）繁殖
~原文 Rabbits are easy to breed because they can produce babies in a period of only thirty days.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The color red is often ______ with war, energy, and danger.
A: criticized
B: interfered
C: motivated
D: associated
= D
~詞義 associate（v.）聯想
~原文 The color red is often associated with war, energy, and danger.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The tired family ______ themselves to taking a slower route home, accepting that the main road would remain blocked for hours.
A: prompted
B: resigned
C: explained
D: attached
= B
~詞義 resign（v.）無奈接受(resign oneself to V-ing)
~原文 The tired family resigned themselves to taking a slower route home, accepting that the main road would remain blocked for hours.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The new electric car has the most ______ battery of all time.
A: critical
B: fluent
C: durable
D: grateful
= C
~詞義 durable（adj.）耐用的
~原文 The new electric car has the most durable battery of all time.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After a month of silence, the United Nations finally decided to ______ in the country's civil war.
A: maintain
B: interfere
C: retain
D: dismiss
= B
~詞義 interfere（v.）干涉
~原文 After a month of silence, the United Nations finally decided to interfere in the country's civil war.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: In order to be successful, you need to have high ______. Otherwise, you will give up easily.
A: motivation
B: outcome
C: retirement
D: dynasty
= A
~詞義 motivation（n.）動機
~原文 In order to be successful, you need to have high motivation. Otherwise, you will give up easily.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: fundamentals
B: monitor
C: moderate
D: renewable
E: assured
F: prompted

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Even experienced musicians revisit the ______ to improve rhythm, accuracy, and overall performance quality.
= A
~詞義 fundamental（n.）基本法則
~原文 Even experienced musicians revisit the fundamentals to improve rhythm, accuracy, and overall performance quality.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Solar panels are becoming popular because they provide ______ power without producing harmful pollution.
= D
~詞義 renewable（adj.）可再生的
~原文 Solar panels are becoming popular because they provide renewable power without producing harmful pollution.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The guard is watching the ______ very closely so that no strangers can pass without being noticed.
= B
~詞義 monitor（n.）監視器
~原文 The guard is watching the monitor very closely so that no strangers can pass without being noticed.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Drinking ______ amounts of coffee—about two cups a day—is more likely to benefit your health than harm it.
= C
~詞義 moderate（adj.）適度的
~原文 Drinking moderate amounts of coffee—about two cups a day—is more likely to benefit your health than harm it.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: Max's interest in historic buildings ______ him to read many history books.
= F
~詞義 prompt（v.）促使
~原文 Max's interest in historic buildings prompted him to read many history books.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: conference
B: ethnic
C: dismissed
D: harsh
E: restore
F: critics

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Before the people could ______ their quake-stricken village, a fierce typhoon hit it.
= E
~詞義 restore（v.）恢復
~原文 Before the people could restore their quake-stricken village, a fierce typhoon hit it.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Jeremy's mother is quite ______ with him. For example, she often scolds him if his performance doesn't meet her expectations.
= D
~詞義 harsh（adj.）嚴厲的
~原文 Jeremy's mother is quite harsh with him. For example, she often scolds him if his performance doesn't meet her expectations.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: Since the movie came out, it has received many favorable reviews from both ______ and viewers.
= F
~詞義 critic（n.）評論家
~原文 Since the movie came out, it has received many favorable reviews from both critics and viewers.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: Scholars of various nationalities are participating in this international ______.
= A
~詞義 conference（n.）會議
~原文 Scholars of various nationalities are participating in this international conference.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Since the professor had a meeting to attend, he ______ the class earlier this morning.
= C
~詞義 dismiss（v.）解散
~原文 Since the professor had a meeting to attend, he dismissed the class earlier this morning.
